title: Quote Templates
meta: Reusable quote and proposal templates in your CRM that go out faster and look professional. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Quote templates that go out in minutes
overview: We turn the quotes you already send into clean, reusable templates inside your CRM, with your logo, product lines, prices and terms. A salesperson picks the deal, fills a few fields and sends a polished quote or proposal in minutes. We write friendly wording for each section, add your payment and validity terms and test the output as a PDF. You get a short guide on how to update prices without breaking the layout.

pkgs.blurb: One branded quote template, ready to send from a deal.
Three templates with product lines, terms and e-sign link.
A full quote kit with proposals, approvals and a price list.
list: Cover page and case study block

faq: Can quotes pull prices from my CRM?
Yes, if your CRM supports product or price lists. We load your products with their prices so a quote fills in by itself. If your plan does not support it, we build the template with fixed lines.
Do you write the proposal wording?
Yes. We draft clear sections such as scope, timeline and terms in your voice, based on past quotes you send us. A person on your team reviews the text before the first quote goes out.
If you already use an e-sign tool, we add the link or button to the template. We do not provide legal terms. Have your own adviser review the contract wording you place in the template.
We set the tax label and the currency your CRM supports on the quote. Complex tax rules should be confirmed with your accountant, and we tell you where we have assumed a standard rate.
